## Summary

Describe the website or documentation change.

## Product sync

When this PR documents a user-facing Dockavel feature, service, runtime, source preset, CLI command, configuration option, port, workflow or behavior:

- [ ] matching runtime change in `AfshinEfati/dockavel` is linked or already merged
- [ ] English and Persian documentation remain aligned
- [ ] landing page is updated when the capability belongs in the product overview
- [ ] sitemap is updated if a new documentation route was added
- [ ] links remain compatible with the current GitHub Pages project URL and a future custom domain

If this is only a visual/internal site change, explain why runtime documentation sync is not required.
